annotations.title: Edit a Trade Desk ad group

description: Change a Trade Desk ad group: name, budget, dailyBudget, baseBidCpm, maxBidCpm (each changes spend, so confirm:true after the user says yes), or creativeIds (the creatives it serves; the list REPLACES the old one, so leaving one out takes it off the ad group). Read back. Free.
name: update_trade_desk_ad_group
